notes:
NOT restricted per stream, deliberately. All eight streams observe the same 5 of these 9 labels, because only 98 of 2,086 trials (4.7%) reach a 6 s window and the four that vanish are the shortest exercise variants. That is a consequence of the analysis window, not of the acquisition protocol, so the candidate set stays at 9 and the missing classes are simply absent from the evaluated population.
OPEN DESIGN QUESTION: six of the nine labels are `squat` / `squat_with_...` and `walking` / `walking_with_...` variants that differ only by a trailing clause. A language-conditioned scorer cannot separate those from text, so a flat 9-way number is not a clean measure of either exercise identity or execution quality. Intended reporting is 3-way exercise identity plus a separate correct-versus-incorrect cell. See docs/data/DATASET_EXPANSION_AUDIT_2026-08-11.md section 2.4.
